svg.title: Semi-synthetic feature selection and cross-seed stability

cc:Work.dc:title: Semi-synthetic feature selection and cross-seed stability
cc:Work.dc:description: Concept eligibility is estimated on cfc_train with a joint factorial model and BH FDR. Response recurrence requires |r| ≥ 0.5; strong decoder geometry requires |cosine| ≥ 0.8; stable atoms span at least two of three seeds through edges satisfying both thresholds. JumpReLU has response recurrence but no strong decoder agreement. Panels a and d use log-like scales to keep low-count methods visible.
